subject: Close choreography: evaluation gates and settlement lane for Emerald Health private offer
messages:
From: Ellis Chang <ellis.chang@emeraldhealth.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Li <hannah.li@emeraldhealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood private offer — procurement & evaluation cadence

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Emerald is keen to move a scoped evaluation into our AWS private offer path (we need the MPA so procurement can run the PO through our finance system). Before we lock timelines I wanted to confirm two things:

1) Can Redwood provide a short mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out our acceptance gates (tech eval milestones + sign-off roles) and the expected dates?
2) For billing, would you accept a Net-30 invoice from Redwood once the PO is issued, or do you require marketplace commit billing through the AWS Private Offer flow?

Attached is our standard PO template (PDF) for your finance review — we can get a draft PO to you within 48 hours once terms are aligned.

High level target from our side: start eval by 6/28, production acceptance window 7/26–8/02, billing effective on PO issuance. Can Redwood align to that cadence?

Appreciate a quick MAP sketch and any blockers we should track.

Best,
Ellis
Director, Procurement
Emerald Health
(attachment: Emerald_PO_template.pdf)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ellis Chang <ellis.chang@emeraldhealth.ai>
Cc: Hannah Li <hannah.li@emeraldhealth.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood private offer — procurement & evaluation cadence

Hi Ellis — thanks for the clarity and the PO template. We're aligned on moving this via an AWS Private Offer. Below is a compact MAP (close choreography) we propose so procurement, legal, and the technical teams have clear gates and handoffs. I’ll follow up with a short calendar invite for the MAP kickoff.

Mutual Action Plan (summary):
- Gate 1 (Kickoff / Access): 6/22 — RDW provides private-offer SKU + credentials, Emerald confirms test accounts (owner: Ellis).
- Gate 2 (Sanity Eval): 6/28–7/02 — Emerald runs smoke tests (latency/cost targets). Quick sync 7/02 to sign off go/no-go.
- Gate 3 (Deep Eval + Security Evidence): 7/05–7/16 — Redwood delivers SOC-2 artifact links, KMS/HSM notes, and optional on-prem checklist.
- Gate 4 (Acceptance & PO Issuance): 7/19 — Emerald issues PO (expected Net-30), sign-off by procurement + technical lead.
- Gate 5 (Production Enablement): 7/26 — Enable production SKUs, billing becomes effective per PO or AWS private offer settlement (see billing path below).

Billing path options (we recommend a primary + fallback):
- Primary: AWS Private Offer settlement (recommended if Emerald wants consolidated marketplace invoicing). Redwood will accept marketplace settlement and provide invoice reconciliation statements monthly.
- Fallback: Direct Net-30 invoice from Redwood after PO issuance (Redwood Finance can accept). Note: direct invoices require an internal billing code and SSO/KMS keys confirmation; this can add 3–5 business days to enablement.

Open items for procurement/legal:
- Which billing path do you prefer (Marketplace settlement vs Redwood Net-30)?
- Any required PO verbiage beyond standard terms (we reviewed Emerald_PO_template and it looks standard).

I’m cc’ing Jordan (Finance) and Marissa (Legal) to chime in on the billing enablement steps and any contract redlines.

Next steps:
1) Confirm preferred billing path (reply here).
2) MAP kickoff call — proposed: Wed 6/16 10:00–10:30 PT.
3) We’ll upload a one-page MAP doc to the shared link after the call.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(attachment: Redwood_Private_Offer_Summary.pdf)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ellis Chang <ellis.chang@emeraldhealth.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Li <hannah.li@emeraldhealth.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood private offer — procurement & evaluation cadence

Ellis, Soojin — quick note from Finance:

We can support either billing path described by Soojin. Operational considerations:
- If Emerald chooses AWS Private Offer settlement, finance will reconcile via marketplace invoice feeds; we will provide monthly reconciliation CDs and a point-of-contact. Turn-up is typically 1 business day after the PO is visible in the private-offer configuration.
- If Emerald chooses Net-30 direct invoicing, please confirm account code and remit address in your PO. We will need the PO number before issuing an invoice; standard Net-30 payment terms apply.

Two requests for a smooth enablement:
1) Please share the named procurement contact and the email where we should route the invoice.
2) If direct invoicing, include Emerald’s tax ID and remit address in the PO PDF (we can accept e-invoice as PDF via emailed attachment).

Marissa — from Legal: any notable redlines we should expect from Emerald based on the PO template?

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Ellis Chang <ellis.chang@emeraldhealth.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Li <hannah.li@emeraldhealth.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@emeraldhealth.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood private offer — procurement & evaluation cadence

Thanks everyone — Emerald prefers the AWS Private Offer settlement as primary. A couple of clarifying notes:

- Procurement lead for routing: procurement@emeraldhealth.ai (they handle invoice ingestion).
- We will upload the PO to DocuSign by 7/19 (requested signing window 7/19–7/21). PO will include tax ID and remit address; we’ll link the DocuSign envelope once it’s ready.
- Technical contact for acceptance: Hannah Li (cc’d) — she will run the deep eval and confirm acceptance on 7/19.

We attached a filled PO skeleton. Please confirm: does Redwood need any specific AWS Private Offer configuration fields (Seller-SKU mapping, marketplace contract id) to complete the private-offer setup? If yes, Jordan — can Redwood provide that mapping by 6/21 to avoid a rollout delay?

(attachment: Emerald_PO_template_filled.pdf)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ellis Chang <ellis.chang@emeraldhealth.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Li <hannah.li@emeraldhealth.ai>, procurement@emeraldhealth.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood private offer — procurement & evaluation cadence

Ellis — perfect, thanks for the confirmation and the PO skeleton. We’ll treat AWS Private Offer settlement as primary. Quick summary (this will be our running MAP and checklist):

Immediate items (complete by 6/21):
- Redwood to provide Seller-SKU mapping + private-offer contract id (Jordan).
- Redwood to upload one-page MAP and acceptance criteria to shared link: https://docs.redwood.ai/sales/DL-47219-map (Soojin).

Evaluation windows:
- Sanity eval: 6/28–7/02 (Hannah leads)
- Deep eval/security artifact delivery: 7/05–7/16 (Marissa to share SOC-2 pointers; Redwood will share minimal KMS details)
- PO issuance & DocuSign: 7/19 (Ellis/procurement will send envelope)
- Production enablement: 7/26 (billing effective via AWS settlement)

Jordan — please confirm when Seller-SKU mapping and the private-offer contract id will be available; early delivery helps Emerald’s procurement team validate the AWS marketplace configuration.

I’ll set the MAP kickoff for Wed 6/16 10:00 PT (calendar invite to follow). Thanks all — looking forward to a smooth close choreography.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(attachments: Redwood_Invoice_Terms.docx)
